patterns: Persistent truthful price and action hierarchy

must: Preserve RTL Persian typography and natural letter joining
Use backend-supported data and truthful availability states
Keep 44px touch targets, visible focus, and reduced-motion behavior
Prevent horizontal overflow at 320px and wider
avoid: Generic glassmorphism or decorative gradients outside established tokens
Fabricated ratings, discounts, tags, or availability

decisions: Canonical product grids use auto-fill tracks with a mobile-safe 20rem preferred minimum and no four-column squeeze.
Product cards use a framed square media stage, prominent category and tag context, truthful availability, persistent commerce controls, and a compact price/detail footer.
21st.dev Product Cards 5650 and 8286 informed the image-led hierarchy and restrained commerce layout; Rumera primitives and live contracts remain authoritative.
